title: Align AGENTS with web-first paper lookup
description: Updates the main agent prompt so specific-paper lookup starts with native websearch/webfetch and uses arc_lookup_paper only as fallback or metadata enrichment.
changes: Remove the first-round requirement to call arc_lookup_paper for concrete paper names.
Require lightweight native websearch/webfetch first for specific-paper lookup.
Keep arc_lookup_paper as fallback or metadata enrichment.
Keep arc_search_literature reserved for topic-level literature review and survey tasks.

rollback.notes: Restore the previous AGENTS snapshot if web-first paper lookup reduces recall.
